prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] home_intro_two_column_redesign: Redesign the final home_intro screen into a structured two-column layout highlighting pet desktop controls and companion readiness.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your pet now lives on your desktop screen. Learn how to interact and manage your pet."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_carousel_flow: Transform pet selection on the pick_friend screen into an interactive carousel flow showing pet personalities and traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Explore Pet Personalities", "body": "Swipe through available pets to pick the perfect companion for your desktop."}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] reorder_sign_in_after_adoption: Move the sign_in step to occur right after pet adoption selection instead of before choosing a pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_screen] new_screen_desktop_readiness_prep: Add a new screen called new_desktop_prep before waiting to verify desktop window permissions and audio options.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Checking desktop window permissions and rendering support...", "style": "plain"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_desktop_prep", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_tip_carousel: Add a tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining pet desktop interactions while assets load.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick options.", "style": "calm"}]}}
5: [home, notification] waiting_desktop_completion_notification: Enable system notification alerts on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet finishes generating.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your companion is ready!"}}
6: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_visibility_hint: Add a prominent taskbar hint component on home_intro clarifying where the pet app icon resides.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Can't find your pet? Check the app icon in your system taskbar.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Taskbar Icon Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, incentive] adoption_certificate_badge_incentive: Display a playful companion badge component on adoption_certificate to celebrate adoption completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Companion Certified", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_reassurance_copy: Update choose_path headline and body text to clarify that chosen paths can be adjusted anytime later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet Journey", "body": "Select your preferred start path. You can customize your companion settings anytime later."}}
9: [sign_in, layout] sign_in_centered_layout: Switch the sign_in screen to a focused centered layout emphasizing account synchronization benefits.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "body": "Connect your account so your desktop pet and settings remain saved across sessions."}}
